title: Adopted transformation inputs
description: The run's own immutable copy of the generated transformations one artifact refinement iteration judged. The raw response and this adopted input are both run-scoped, so the bytes behind a recorded result stay recoverable.

iteration.description: Refinement iteration these inputs belong to.

model.description: Transformation model recorded by the run manifest; null when the run has no transformation branch.

strategy.description: Prompting strategy recorded by the run manifest.

path.description: Path of the run's copy, relative to the run directory.

source.description: Path the copy was taken from, repository-relative when it lies in the repository.
